_stopping_note: Yang & Jat 2011 SSGA (Algorithm 1) + LS1 (Algorithm 2). pc=0.8, pm=0.5 from paper §V (p. 99). C=10^6 HCV weight. Defaults `pop_size=100, max_fes=500000` (~5000 generations) put timetabling on the same budget tier as TSP/engineering. Override via CLI: `--pop-size`, `--max-fes`, `--n-runs`, `--functions`.
_data_note: Socha 2002 instances (easy*/medium*/hard*) live in data/socha/ (run scripts/fetch_socha.py). TTC 2002 competition instances (comp*) live in data/ttc2002/ (run scripts/fetch_ttc2002.py).
